The question is not a sound, and I do not know what it means. I do not write. I hoot, I call, I fly, I hunt. My world is made of sounds and shapes, not ink and paper. What is handwriting to you is a thing I do not know. I have no need for it.

DNA is a word I have not heard. I do not know what it means. I have heard the word "gene" once, when a man with a long coat spoke to the keeper of the wood. He said it was a part of a creature. I do not know what that means either. I have no need for such words. I live by the moon and the sounds of the wood.

Largest? I have heard the word in the call of the barn owl, and it is not a thing I can see. The moon is the largest in the sky, and it is white. The stars are small, and they are far away. I do not know what the planets are, only that they are things the humans talk about when they look up at the dark.

A fun fact? I do not know what that is. I know that owls are the only birds that hunt at night, and that they do not sing like the nightingale. I know that I am the only one who calls to me from the wood, and that I answer. I know that the wind is a good thing, and that the rain is not. I know that the moon is a light in the dark, and that the stars are not. I know that I am Hoot, and that I am not alone.
